title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Audio-Visual Speech Error Correction with Dual Hypotheses

layout.note: Two titled panels side by side, each a bottom-up lane (media, ASR or VSR, hypothesis cards, LLM, output sentence) so that the same stages sit at the same heights in both; the right panel is about 1.6 times wider and holds the red dashed frame.

lesson: Draw the baseline and the proposed method as the same bottom-up lane in two panels, with the changed parts in a single accent colour and a different output sentence on top, so the difference is read at a glance.
